whole_lifecycle_findings.observation: Fixed local checkout declares Minecraft1.21.1/NeoForge21.1.200. @Mod constructor invokes ModSetup.setup, creates MagicManager, registers spell/effect/item buses. Spell/effect declarations select InvisibilitySpell and TrueInvisibilityEffect. This is a local declared source chain, not loaded Dynasty registry or remote tree authentication.

ModSetup binds MagicEvents.onWorldTick to NeoForge event bus. Handler returns client-side then dispatches MagicManager.tick. CastPacket carries no entity-ID payload and enqueues its context ServerPlayer into Utils.serverSideInitiateCast; selection routes to attemptInitiateCast. Selection manager internals are not expanded.

AbstractSpell attempt initiation rejects client/already-casting/canBeCastedBy/precondition/event-cancel branches, then starts casting and submits state/start packets. MagicManager LONG-completion path dispatches castSpell. Native event bus, use-item scheduling and all external selectors are not validated.

Spell cast submits SpellOnCastEvent; applicable mana subtraction/sync precede onCast. Invisibility onCast requests TRUE_INVISIBILITY with duration(int)(getSpellPower*20), amplifier0, ambientfalse, particlesfalse, icontrue and ignores addEffect return. Sound, armor-slot particles, cooldown/recast and OnClientCast dispatch are not an accepted-effect receipt or transaction rollback.

TrueInvisibility onEffectAdded constructs combat targeting conditions ignoring LOS plus exact current target==protected LivingEntity, asks level for nearby Mob candidates inside bbox.inflate40. Other inherited combat eligibility/visibility/query behavior is native1.21-unexpanded; do not claim all mobs in40 cleared. No own server guard in this override.

For each returned pursuer callback calls setTarget(null), stops every available targetSelector WrappedGoal and erases only Brain ATTACK_TARGET. It does not remove goal registrations, stop every goalSelector/brain task, explicitly clear all revenge/anger memories or check actual clearing success. Native WrappedGoal1.21 and setter arbitration unexpanded.

ServerPlayerEvents new-target listener first handles village-allies and hostile-summon exceptions; nonnull new target with TRUE_INVISIBILITY then setCanceled(true). Its own branch has no ring/light/owner/Boss gate or explicit side guard. Null target skips this handler own veto; other listeners/engine unexpanded.

TrueInvisibility subscribed LivingIncomingDamageEvent resolves event DamageSource.getEntity causing attacker, and requests removing TRUE_INVISIBILITY from that LivingEntity. This is not direct-projectile equality, incoming victim protection or damage cancellation. Own handler checks neither amount nor final HP/success; event priority/cancellation dispatch and ordering remain unexpanded.

MagicMobEffect empty removal callback gives no custom old-AI/goal/target restoration. Source wrapper comments describe added-first-time versus started/updated, but native1.21 admission/update/expiry/removal dispatch is not read. No assertion every refresh resweeps mobs or that invisibility remains forever after removal.

LivingEntityMixin server-side add/update hooks broadcast ClientboundUpdateMobEffectPacket for ISyncedMobEffect; removal hook runs end callback and broadcasts ClientboundRemoveMobEffectPacket. StartTracking separately submits current synced effects. These packets identify numeric entity/effect state, not a control-refusal reason; native1.21 packet consumption, recipient delivery and order untested.

LivingEntityMixin updateInvisibilityStatus TAIL setsInvisible(true) only if effect exists. Client beforeLivingRender requires local player and active effect and isInvisibleTo(observer), then cancels rendering. Native base invisible-flag restore/isInvisibleTo, other render layers/backend and actual pixels are not read or tested.

EntityMixin isInvisibleTo HEAD returns false when observer player has equipped INVISIBILITY_RING. Item declaration constructs InvisibiltyRing; full ring is a descriptive Curio RING_SLOT, not effect producer. Server target veto never reads ring in its shown branch, so observer rendering exception is separate from shown AI protection. Curio equipment check implementation is not expanded.

Mixin config lists EntityMixin and LivingEntityMixin and neoforge.mods.toml binds config. MixinPlugin permits these noncompat classes by its own logic. ISyncedMobEffect default clientTick is empty; OnClientCast resolves spell and invokes spell onClientCast on local player. None is a target-specific rejection receipt, runtime mixin proof, universal immunity or new semantic credit.
